blocks.text: LIVE: Alex Eala vs Claire Liu – Hong Kong Open final MANILA, Philippines–What could’ve been a second WTA title for Alex Eala turned into a breakthrough victory for American Claire Liu on Sunday night. Eala came up short in putting the finishing touch on a historic season after falling to a feisty Liu, 3-6, 0-6, in the Hong Kong Open final. Despite the heartbreaking defeat, an emotional Eala remained gracious in defeat.
